title: Claude Code Skill Schema
description: Schema for Claude Code skill YAML frontmatter - https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills

name.description: Skill name. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only (max 64 characters). Should match the directory name.

description.description: Third-person capability description with trigger terms (max 1024 characters). Claude uses this to decide when to apply the skill.

allowed-tools.description: Tools Claude can use without asking permission when this skill is active

model.description: Model to use when this skill is active (e.g., claude-sonnet-4-20250514). Defaults to the conversation's model.

context.description: Set to 'fork' to run the skill in a forked sub-agent context with its own conversation history

agent.description: Agent type to use when context: fork is set (e.g., Explore, Plan, general-purpose, or custom agent name). Defaults to general-purpose.

user-invocable.description: Controls whether the skill appears in the slash command menu. Does not affect the Skill tool or automatic discovery.

disable-model-invocation.description: Block programmatic invocation via the Skill tool. Does not affect slash menu or auto-discovery.
